summary: Iteration 4 (Friends system) tested end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_friends.py (37 tests) covering seed (6 accounts / real channel owners), GET /api/relationship/{handle} (friends, follow-back, self, plain-follow, 404s), GET /api/friends (creator=2, viewer/kid/flavorfield=[]), GET /api/friends/feed (videos+clips restricted to friend handles, learn_mode filter, sort order), GET /api/followers (4 followers with correct is_mutual flags), mutual toggle + unfriend flows (self-restoring), per-profile isolation of follows/likes/history, and core-endpoint regression. Full backend suite = 93/93 passing. Frontend: verified /friends no-channel state (viewer + kid), 3 tabs with correct counts, 2 friend cards + unfriend, 4 follower cards with 'Follow back' on flavorfield and 'Friends' on mutual entries, channel-follow-btn data-rel states (owner/friends/follow-back/follow), full Follow back -> Friends -> unfollow round trip with /friends count going 2->3->2, sidebar nav-friends after Following, account switch resetting Learn Mode, and mobile layout. Found and fixed one crash: /library threw 'account is not defined' (missing destructure in Library.jsx). All mutated data restored (follows table byte-identical to seed, likes=0, no TEST_ videos).

minor.issue: account_id is a plain query param with a hardcoded DEFAULT_ACCOUNT fallback; an unknown account_id silently returns empty lists on /friends and /followers instead of 404 (relationship correctly 404s). Inconsistent error semantics.
limit is applied separately to videos and clips (single 'limit' param controls both lists), which is ambiguous for pagination later.
Endpoint still lazily re-seeds default follows for acc-viewer-01 when its follow list is empty (side-effecting GET). Harmless now but will silently resurrect follows the user deliberately removed.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: `const { likes } = useApp()` omitted `account`, so /library crashed with ReferenceError: account is not defined (blank white screen + react-error-overlay). Regression from the iteration-4 per-account refactor.

Friend card is a <Link> to the channel with a nested unfriend <button>; the button relies on e.preventDefault() to suppress navigation. It works, but the affordance is fragile/nested-interactive (a11y). Button label says 'Unfollow' while the review request calls it an unfriend button — consider 'Unfriend' for clarity.

issues: No error state: api.friendsFeed/api.followers failures are swallowed (no .catch on followers, no error UI), so a backend failure renders an indistinguishable 'empty' page.
Channel h1 sits on the banner/gradient boundary (-mt-10) and the large title visually touches the banner edge on 1920px; slightly tight but legible.

Thumbnail/topic mismatch persists from seed randomization (e.g. 'Why quantum entanglement is real' uses a food photo, 'Learn to read a financial statement' sits on Flavor Field cooking channel). Cosmetic only, pre-existing.

action_items: Review the Library.jsx one-line fix applied by tester (added `account` to useApp destructure) and audit remaining pages for the same missing-destructure pattern after per-account refactors.
Add error/failure states to Friends.jsx for friendsFeed/followers API calls (currently failures render as empty state).
Optional: return 404 for unknown account_id on /api/friends and /api/followers for consistency with /api/relationship.
Optional: remove the side-effecting default-follow seeding inside GET /api/following/feed.
critical_code_review_comments: Library.jsx used `account` without destructuring it from useApp() — this class of bug is invisible until the route is visited; consider an ESLint no-undef gate in CI (eslint already flags it).
_friend_account_ids() runs 3 sequential queries per call and is invoked by /friends, /friends/feed and /followers; fine for a prototype but should be a single aggregation before real data volumes.

Friends.jsx useEffect depends on the whole `friends` array object; every refreshFriends() re-creates the array and re-triggers friendsFeed + followers fetches. Works, but causes duplicate network calls per toggle.

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all Friends-system flows pass; 1 route crash found and fixed)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. All mutations were self-restoring; verified follows collection is byte-identical to the 10 seeded rows, likes=0, no TEST_ videos/channels left. Repaired acc-friend-01 identity (username/avatar) that a stale iteration-3 test had corrupted to 'TESTQL95113'.
test_credentials: No auth. Profiles: acc-viewer-01, acc-creator-01, acc-kid-01, acc-friend-01/02/03. Switch via account-menu-trigger -> switch-account-{id} or localStorage 'vp_account_id'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already sets -n 2 --dist loadscope; conftest has a file lock serializing shared-state mutations). test_friends.py covers all iteration-4 Friends endpoints and restores its own state. Beware: tests that PUT a channel now also mutate the owning ACCOUNT identity for codeatlas/quantumlens/chroniclepath/flavorfield — always restore accounts.username/avatar too, otherwise the friends seed assertions break. Frontend account switching via localStorage.setItem('vp_account_id', id) + reload works reliably. Remaining untested: notifications bell, Clips swipe interactions, playlists tab.
rca_of_the_issue: /library blank screen RCA: iteration 4 moved history to a per-account API (api.history(account.id)). Library.jsx was updated to call it inside a useEffect keyed on `account`, but `account` was never added to the `const { likes } = useApp()` destructure, so the component threw ReferenceError on first render and CRA's error overlay replaced the page. Fix: destructure `account` from useApp(). Verified /library now renders History/Liked/Playlists tabs for both viewer and creator with per-account data and zero console errors.
